data.name: Anahita
data.long_meaning: In ancient Persian mythology, Anahita was the goddess of water, fertility, and the protector of travellers. She was also considered the goddess of abundance, generosity, and good fortune.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anahita represents the divine feminine and the nurturing, life-giving force of water. She embodies the qualities of compassion, love, and abundance. Her spiritual meaning can inspire us to connect with the natural world, embrace the cycles of life, and cultivate inner peace and harmony.

Its association with fertility also highlights the importance of agriculture in ancient Persian culture and societies. Moreover, Anahita as the protector of travellers reflects the value placed on hospitality and shared kindness within communities.
data.spiritual_significance: Symbolically, the Islamic name Anahita carries spiritual depth as it embodies the essence of mercy, compassion, and grace that blesses all creation.
